description_en: Migrates cloud computers from the current office network (formerly known as workspace) to a new office network
description_zh: 将云电脑从当前所属办公网络（原工作区）迁移到新的办公网络
kebab_example: aliyun ecd migrate-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-office-site-id cn-shenzhen+dir-3885050000 --desktop-id ecd-39clsqyxr0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target office network
parameters.name: target_office_site_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: target_subnet_id

parameters.help_en: The member IP address of the target node for migration
parameters.help_zh: 迁移目标节点的成员 IP 地址
parameters.name: target_member_ip

parameters.help_en: The IDs of cloud computers. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id
